title: Written Estimate Threshold, Overage Tolerance and Fleet Pre-Authorization Limits — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
| Tier | Written estimate required above (customer-pay amount, USD) | Estimate overage tolerance | Fleet pre-authorized amount per concern line (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Service Guest Account | 25.00 | 10% | 0.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 25.00 | 10% | 0.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 25.00 | 10% | 0.00 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 25.00 | 10% | 0.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 | 25.00 | 10% | 750.00 |
| Commercial Fleet Account - Net 30 | 25.00 | 10% | 1500.00 |

These are the estimate figures of each tier of **Service Accounts and Repair Orders**.
- The threshold is the customer-pay amount above which a concern line needs a written estimate the customer authorizes.
- The estimate overage tolerance is the share of an authorized estimate amount by which the final customer-pay charges of the line may exceed it.
- The fleet pre-authorized amount is the customer-pay amount per concern line a fleet account authorizes in advance; on the retail tiers it is 0.00, so nothing is authorized in advance.

Hypothetical reading: at the 10% tolerance, an authorized estimate of 620.00 is exceeded beyond its tolerance once the line's final customer-pay charges pass 682.00.
